content: | Known for | Founder of Boston Consulting Group |. **Bruce Doolin Henderson** (April 30, 1915 – July 20, 1992) was an American businessman and management expert. He founded Boston Consulting Group (BCG) in 1963 in Boston, Massachusetts and headed the firm as the president and CEO until 1980. Henderson was born on a farm in Nashville, Tennessee on April 30, 1915. In the fourth grade, he enrolled in the Peabody Demonstration School (PDS) and remained there until his high school graduation in 1932. In 1959, Henderson left the company to join the consulting firm Arthur D. Little, Henderson accepted a challenge from the CEO of Boston Company to create a consulting arm for the bank, operating as a subsidiary under the name Management and Consulting Division of the Boston Safe Deposit and Trust Company. Henderson stepped down from his role as the president and CEO of Boston Consulting Group in 1980.

title: Profile of Boston Consulting Group
content: ## The Top Global Consulting Firms >. Profile of Boston Consulting Group. Boston Consulting Group Overview, Profile, and History. **Boston Consulting Group** **(BCG)** is one of the world’s leading management consulting firms, renowned for its pioneering strategy work and influential business frameworks. Henderson, BCG began as a bold new approach to corporate consulting, focusing on business strategy as its specialty​. Over six decades, the firm has grown into a global partnership with tens of thousands of consultants, known for helping organizations solve complex problems and gain competitive advantage​. BCG was established in 1963 as the management consulting division of the Boston Safe Deposit and Trust Company by Bruce D. Notably, a group of BCG consultants led by Bill Bain left in 1973 to form Bain & Company, another major strategy firm, but BCG continued to thrive on its own. By the late 1980s, the firm had established practice areas in key industries – financial services, consumer products/retail, health care, and high tech – as well as functional specialties in operations and M&A.
